title: Super perfect
text:
Super perfect. I got these for on my TV stand shelf with some led candles they add a great touch
I needed a little extra fleur-de-lis in that area to accent and these were perfect

product_metadata.title: Candle Holder/Wine Coaster - Fleur de Lis Design - Brass Finish w/Crystals -3" Dia.
features: Versatile home decor. Use as a pillar candle holder or a wine bottle coaster (3" in dia)
Beautiful fleur de lis, scroll design is 2 7/8" to the top of the fleur de lis
3" diameter coaster fits either a 3" pillar candle or most wine bottles (3" dia)
Brass finish and embellished with crystals. Function with Style.
